title: serving-runtime-scratchpad-2026-04-08
content:
Daily scratchpad - 2026-04-08
Owner: Riley Chen (eng-serving-runtime)
Collab: Aisha P., Marco R.

Top priorities:
- Triage perf regression on nv-gpu-03 after last deploy (2026-04-07 22:15 UTC). Lat p95 jumped from 85ms -> 210ms for short chat workloads.
- Finish kernel patch test for fused-attention and run end-to-end eval.
- Follow up on kv-cache eviction bug (SERV-512) causing stale replies for pinned sessions.

Observations / quick notes:
- Regression appears correlated with change in batching heuristics (PR #241): dynamic_batcher change to prefer larger batches at low qps. Hypothesis: increased tail latency due to batch formation delay when sequence lengths vary.
- Reproducer: run local load with mix: 60% short (32 tokens), 40% long (512 tokens) and target qps 120 on nv-gpu-03. Script: tools/run_bench.sh --profile short_long_mix --qps 120 --gpu nv-gpu-03
- Rough shell trace from 2026-04-07 22:40 (attached in GH PR comments): many requests waiting ~120ms in batch_queue before dispatch.

Immediate triage steps (today):
1) Roll back batching heuristic change on staging and run the bench to confirm latency drop. Action: revert commit 9c3a1d in staging branch. (Riley)
2) Add logging for batch formation time and per-request wait time; patch in PR #243. (Aisha)
3) Re-run perf with quantized kernels disabled to rule out kernel scheduling interactions. Command: env DISABLE_QUANT_KERNELS=1 ./tools/run_bench.sh --profile short_long_mix --qps 120 (Marco)
4) Reproduce kv-cache eviction: create pinned session with small capacity (cache_size=4), send >8 distinct prefixes and verify eviction order. Steps in SERV-512. (Riley)

Notes on kernel work / TODOs:
- Fused attention patch: current patch reduces mem copies but introduces misaligned loads on odd seq_len; need to add alignment branch. TODO: add test vector for seq_len 127/129. (PR #238)
- Check compatibility with CUDA 12.2 / cuBLAS 13 on nv-gpu-03. There are warnings about half-fp atomic ops. If fused kernel uses atomicAdd for fp16, might be slower on this driver. Run microbench: tools/kernel_bench.sh --kernel fused_attn --iters 5000 --device nv-gpu-03
- Look at moving small-batch fast path to CUDA kernel (skip batch formation if batch_size<=2 and latency bound strict). Prototype in branch fast-path-small-batches. Risk: bypasses KV cache coalescing.

KV-cache eviction bug (SERV-512)
- Symptom: pinned session loses earliest entries unpredictably when cache gets near capacity. Suspect concurrent trim + write race at map->list update.
- Immediate mitigation: increase cache_size default to 32 for Dedicated customers (config flag) and add metrics to track eviction rate per-session. (product okayed temporary increase)
- Longer term: change eviction from in-place list splice to atomic compare-and-swap loop on head pointer (design notes in confluence link).

Quick commands / logs to fetch:
- kubectl logs -n serving runtime-nv-gpu-03 -c runtime --since=2h | grep "batch_queue_wait" -A 10 > /tmp/batch_waits.log
- profiling: sudo perf record -F 99 -g -p $(pidof runtime) -- sleep 30 ; sudo perf script > /tmp/perf.out
- flamegraph: stackcollapse-perf.pl /tmp/perf.out > out.folded ; flamegraph.pl out.folded > flame.svg

Meeting notes (standup 10:30):
- Aisha: landed extra logging PR, will watch staging.
- Marco: running kernel microbench this morning, will reach out if GPU driver anomalies seen.
- Riley: will revert batching change on staging and prepare canary for nv-gpu-03.

Open questions / decisions to make:
- Do we prefer lower average cost (bigger batches) or tighter p95 SLOs for short-chat customers? Need to align with Product (cc: @product-hosted-api).
- If fused kernel degrades on some drivers, should we gate it behind a deviceCapability check at startup?

Follow-ups / next steps:
- By EOD: confirm whether revert on staging fixes p95. If yes, plan hotfix for prod (Riley).
- Add regression test to ci/perf that includes mixed-seq-length scenario (short+long) and checks p95 < 120ms at qps=100. (Marco + Aisha)
- Post-mortem doc stub (if this hits prod): create confluence page with timeline and impact numbers.

Notes to self:
- Remember to update the rollout checklist to include kernel/driver compatibility table.
- Keep a short runbook entry for SERV-512 with commands to inspect cache state and force-trim for customers.

Random TODOs (low priority):
- Investigate opportunity for prefix-cache prefetch for long-context sessions.
- Clean up old feature flags in config repo.

---
End of day quick log: 2026-04-08 18:40 UTC
- Revert applied to staging, initial p95 drops to ~90ms on staging perf. Can prepare hotfix PR for prod with revert and additional logging.
- Kernel bench shows slight slowdown on nv-gpu-03 when atomic fp16 ops used (investigate driver).
summary: Triage of p95 regression caused by batching heuristic change; KV-cache eviction bug follow-up; kernel microbench TODOs
